meta.title: Sidebar menu
meta.description: Control the left sidebar from Settings → "Sidebar menu". Show or fold away the built-in panels (Plugins, Plugin market, Tasks, and any other panel you installed) and keep your own shortcut entries in the sidebar's More menu. Folding a panel only moves it into More: nothing is deleted, and the Plugins panel always stays in the sidebar. DSH keeps panel placement for the current page session only, so the saved layout is re-applied the first time you open the sidebar's More menu after a reload or restart — until then the sidebar shows every panel. Shortcut entries and panel choices are stored in this app and survive a restart.
